text:
joel: dropping a short cost-vs-quality snapshot for helios-9b bring-up (3k sampled chat sessions). quick recs for product/GTN.

mica: headline metrics plz

joel: metrics:
```
helios-9b-int6
 p50 165ms p95 410ms
 avg toks/req 390
 cost / 1M toks $15.60
 GTN multi-turn 0.88

helios-9b-int4
 p50 200ms p95 640ms
 avg toks/req 390
 cost / 1M toks $7.90
 GTN multi-turn 0.81
```

rachel: ~49% cost reduction int4, ~0.07 GTN drop. where is quality hurt?

joel: regressions mainly on: multi-step instruction chains, retrieval-augmented long-context recall (>700 tokens), and structured JSON outputs. single-turn QA and short summaries are near-parity.

mica: recommendation for rollout?

joel: proposed plan:
- default route -> int4 for cost-sensitive tiers; route to int6 when context_tokens > 700 OR user_tier == enterprise OR request flagged structured-output.
- canary: 3% -> 25% over 12 days with 72h shadowing on top product flows.
- gating: nightly GTN diff; require instruction-chain slice delta >= -0.03; JSON-parse failure rate must not exceed 1.5x.

rachel: unit-econ math?

joel: back-of-envelope: all-int6 = $15.6/1M; all-int4 = $7.9/1M. mixed 70% int4 + 30% int6 => ~$10.87/1M (~30% savings). if routing pins 25% to int6 (sensitive/long) -> ~$11.64/1M (~25% savings).

ops-bot: canary flag created: `helios9b-mixed-canary` at 1758675309.

gtn-bot: note added: gating slices = [instruction-chain, long-context-recall, json-fidelity].

mica: GTM blurb for deck?

joel: one-liner: "Helios-9b int4 cuts per-token cost ~49% vs int6 with concentrated regressions in long multi-step and structured-output slices; recommend mixed-fleet routing to achieve ~25-30% unit-cost savings while protecting enterprise and structured-output traffic."

rachel: please add per-slice CSV + 50 failure samples to onboarding.

joel: will upload by EOD. :thumbsup:
